### Breaking changes
- Both the 3.8.0 and the 3.8.0-rc.2 entries point to a migration guide rather than listing breaking changes inline: **"Please read the [migration guide](https://doc.traefik.io/traefik/v3.8/migrate/v3/#v380)."** That guide's content was not provided in the notes supplied, so its specifics cannot be confirmed or ruled out here.
